scope: Independent source review only; experiment results are verified separately. No harness edits made by this reviewer.

findings.issue: Source fencing was called before stopping live paused donor/source processes.
Intermediate pooled hot samples lacked actual current-cache sharing verification after recycle/refill.
findings.reason: Every pooled sample compares current file-offset/PFN pairs against frozen initial common frames and requires >=128MiB, while initial/final group scans independently establish sharing. This is valid only because canonical frames are immutable and never reused.

findings.issue: Stock snapshot clone arm incorrectly inherited three independent boots and timing observation counts.

confirmed_contracts: All Firecracker starts use env -i; stock and patched-DRAM arms receive no FC_POOL_* opt-ins; both CXL arms enable identical hinting.
Actual /proc/PID/exe hashes are checked against the selected arm manifest; stock uses its separate pristine binary.
The original anonymous-RAM donor is stopped/fenced before three stock restores of the same RAM-file inode; common guest identity is intentional, with distinct host VMM process evidence.
Guest timers stop before serial output and correctness postchecks; full read oracle/hash and full recycle fill/verify are intentionally inside the timed body.
Guest-cold samples require zero residency before read and positive block I/O; host backing prewarm is verified separately, so these are not storage-cold timings.
Re-admission occurs after refill and before each pooled hot sample; current-cache PFN observer is validation only.
Fresh QEMU nodes and a separate copied outer storage image are created per arm.
reporting_limits: Do not attribute timing deltas to one source-level mechanism without additional measurements.
Snapshot clone sharing is a distinct stock capability, not independent-boot pooling.
The 15 samples per primary operation come from three guests over five rounds, not 15 independent boots.
The write operation overwrites an initialized guest-private mapping; clone host-level CoW may still occur.
The recycle duration includes eviction, allocation, full stores, full validation loads and unmap; it is not pure CoW fault latency.
